name: Short Cut Baked Sun-Dried Tomato Salmon with Asparagus & Herbed Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss asparagus to coat, then spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunch asparagus
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on another baking sheet coated with a thin layer of oil. Season with salt and pepper, then spread sun-dried tomato pesto over the top in an even layer. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb salmon fillet
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ cup sun-dried tomato pesto

instructions.primary_message: Once heated, place both baking sheets in the oven and bake until salmon easily flakes with a fork and asparagus is tender, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, remove sleeve and spice packet from the potatoes; place package (do not remove or puncture film) in the microwave. Microwave on high for 5 ½ minutes, let stand for 1 minute, then remove from microwave. Carefully remove film, then drizzle potatoes with oil, season with spice packet (to taste), and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (16 oz) pkg ready-to-use microwavable potatoes, garlic-herb flavor
extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Alternatively, the potatoes can be cooked on the stovetop. Fill a large pot with 1-inch of hot water (from the tap); place a steamer basket inside of the pot (the surface of the water should be just under the basket). Remove film from package and transfer potatoes to the basket; cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Once the potatoes are done, use tongs to return them to their package; drizzle potatoes with oil, season with spice packet (to taste), and toss to coat.
To serve, divide salmon, asparagus, and potatoes between plates. Enjoy!
